hero.title: Professional deep cleaning in South West London
hero.seo: End-of-tenancy, after-builders, one-off deep and regular cleaning in {{coverage}}.
hero.lede: Moving out, finishing renovation work, or living with a home that needs a full reset? {{business.owner}} plans each clean around the property’s condition, and agrees the scope and price with you before any work starts. Weekly and fortnightly cleaning is available too.
hero.note: Every quote is based on the property’s size, its condition and what you need done.
hero.caption: {{business.owner}}, owner of {{business.name}}

services.title: End of tenancy, after-builders, deep and regular cleaning
services.intro: One-off cleans and regular visits, each quoted individually. Not sure which fits? Describe the job and {{business.owner}} will advise.

results.title: Real cleaning. Real results.
results.intro: Before-and-after photos from {{business.owner}}’s own jobs. Drag the handle, or use the arrow keys, to compare.
results.galleryLink: See more photos in the gallery

gallery.description: Photos from {{business.owner}}’s own cleaning jobs across {{business.location}}: ovens, cooker hoods, kitchens, bathrooms and skirting boards, before and after.
gallery.title: Gallery of our cleaning work
gallery.intro: Every photo here is from one of {{business.owner}}’s own jobs across {{business.location}}. There are no stock images, and the only edit is blurring product labels.
gallery.intro2: Each clean is planned around what the property needs, so you’ll see the same thing again and again: the parts of a home that a quick clean skips. Tap any photo to see it full size.

catText.ovens: Burnt-on grease on oven shelves and runners, cooker hood filters soaked and degreased, and stainless steel hoods polished without streaks. Inside-oven cleaning is an extra, quoted separately.
catText.kitchens: Hob pan supports, fridge drawers, sinks, plugholes and cupboard fronts: the places where spills and fingerprints build up between cleans.
catText.bathrooms: Shower trays, glass screens, drains, toilets and tiles, descaled and cleaned with natural-based products. This also includes work at a salon pedicure station.
catText.details: Skirting boards, light switches and door frames. These are often the first places a landlord or letting agent checks, and the last a rushed clean reaches.

why.title: Why choose {{business.owner}}?
why.p1: Each clean is planned around the property’s condition and the scope you’ve agreed, not a generic checklist worked through against the clock.
why.h2: You know who is doing the work

why.p3: The scope and quote are agreed before booking, so you know exactly what’s included.

meet.title: Meet {{business.owner}}
meet.contact: When you get in touch, you’re talking to the person who plans your clean, agrees the scope and price with you, and is accountable for the result.

process.p2: The scope and price are confirmed before anything is booked.
process.p3: The date is confirmed and the clean is completed as agreed.
process.pricingTitle: A quote based on your property, not an arbitrary package
process.pricingText: Send the property size, its condition and the type of clean. {{business.owner}} will confirm what’s included and give you a clear price before you book.

eco.title: Natural-based products, thorough results

eco.p2: Please let {{business.owner}} know about any allergies, sensitivities or pets before the clean.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.description: How {{business.name}} uses the details you send through the quote form.
privacy.intro: This notice explains how {{business.name}} uses the details you give us when you ask for a quote.
privacy.collectList:
• Your name and the phone number and/or email address you give us
  • The postcode of the property
  • The service you need and your description of the job, including any dates you mention
  • Whether you’d like to send photos on WhatsApp (photos themselves are sent through WhatsApp, not this form)
privacy.whatsapp: If you message us on WhatsApp instead, your messages and photos are also handled by WhatsApp under its own privacy policy.
privacy.why: Only to reply to your enquiry, prepare a quote and, if you go ahead, arrange the clean. The lawful basis is taking steps at your request before entering into a contract.
privacy.receive: The quote form is delivered to us by {{form.processor}}, which processes it on our behalf.
privacy.rights: You can ask to see, correct or delete the information we hold about you by contacting us using the details above. If you’re unhappy with how we’ve handled your data, you can complain to the Information Commissioner’s Office at ico.org.uk.
privacy.receiveFallback: We don’t sell your details or share them for marketing. They’re only shared with service providers that help us receive and manage enquiries, such as our email provider.
privacy.keepFallback: We keep your details only for as long as we need them to reply to your enquiry and, if you book, to provide the clean and keep the records the law requires. Details from enquiries that don’t lead to a booking are deleted once they’re no longer needed.

eot.metaTitle: End of Tenancy Cleaning Wimbledon | Deep Cleaning by Renata
eot.metaDescription: End of tenancy cleaning in Wimbledon, Putney, Richmond and Barnes for tenants, landlords and letting agents. Room-by-room checklist, price agreed first.
eot.eyebrow: For tenants, landlords and letting agents
eot.h1: End of tenancy cleaning in Wimbledon
eot.lede: Moving out is busy enough. Renata cleans the property to a checklist agreed with you before the day, so the kitchen, the bathrooms and the details that get looked at closely at checkout are done properly, not rushed at the end of a long move.
eot.whoTitle: Who books an end of tenancy clean
eot.whoIntro: The standard is the same whoever books it. What changes is what you need from it.

who.title: Tenants moving out
who.text: You want the property handed back in the condition your tenancy asks for. Share your check-in report or inventory if you have it, and the checklist is built around it.

who.title: Landlords between tenancies
who.text: You need the property ready for the next tenant, and for photos or viewings. Tell Renata when the keys are free and when the next move-in is, and the clean is planned in between.

who.title: Letting agents
who.text: You need one person to deal with, a clear price and the work done to the agreed scope. Access and key handover can be arranged directly with your office.

eot.roomsIntro: A guide to a typical end of tenancy checklist. Your quote confirms exactly what’s included for your property.

rooms.title: Kitchen
items: Cupboards and drawers cleaned inside and out, once emptied

rooms.title: Bathrooms
items: Bath, shower, screen and tiles cleaned and descaled
Drain covers lifted and cleaned where accessible

rooms.title: Bedrooms, living areas and hallways
items: Skirting boards, doors and door frames

eot.extras: Need more? Inside the oven, fridge or freezer cleaning, carpet cleaning and rubbish removal can be added, subject to availability and quoted separately.
eot.proofText: At checkout, attention often goes to the same places: grease in the kitchen, limescale in the bathroom, and dust along skirting boards and around switches. These are the areas a quick clean skips, so they get proper time here. This skirting board and switch are from one of Renata’s own jobs.
eot.prepIntro: A few things that help the day go smoothly.

prep.title: Send the inventory
prep.text: If you have the check-in report or inventory, send it with your enquiry so the checklist can follow it.

prep.title: Empty the property first
prep.text: Cupboards, drawers and wardrobes can only be cleaned inside once they’re empty, so book the clean for after your things have gone.

prep.title: Keep the power and water on
prep.text: A thorough clean needs electricity and hot water, so check both are still connected on the day.

prep.title: Agree access
prep.text: You don’t need to be there, as long as access and key handover are arranged in advance.

eot.faqIntro: No cleaner can honestly promise your deposit back. Deposit decisions are made by your landlord or letting agent, and they cover damage and wear as well as cleaning. What Renata can do is clean properly to the checklist agreed with you.

faqs.q: What if the agent points something out after the clean?
faqs.a: Let Renata know as soon as you can, with a photo if possible. Anything raised is looked at case by case.
Inside the oven is an extra, quoted separately, so mention it in your enquiry if your tenancy needs it. The hob and appliance fronts are part of the kitchen clean.

faqs.q: How is the price worked out?
faqs.a: Every clean is quoted individually, based on the size and condition of the property and what needs doing. You’ll know the scope and price before you book.

builders.metaTitle: After Builders Cleaning Wimbledon | Deep Cleaning by Renata
builders.metaDescription: After-builders cleaning in Wimbledon and South West London for homeowners, builders and developers. Fine dust removed, in one visit or two stages.
builders.eyebrow: After extensions, refurbishments and new kitchens
builders.lede: Building work leaves behind a fine dust that settles on every surface and keeps coming back. Renata clears it properly, so you can see the finished work and start using the space again.
builders.dustTitle: Why building dust needs its own clean
builders.dust1: Plastering, sanding and cutting make dust far finer than everyday household dust. It drifts into cupboards, onto door tops, along skirting boards and into light fittings, and it carries on settling for days after the work stops.
builders.dust2: A quick dust or vacuum often just moves it around. That’s why an after-builders clean works from the top of each room down, collecting what falls on the way and finishing with the floors.
builders.stagesTitle: One clean or two, depending on the project
builders.stagesIntro: A smaller job may only need one final clean. On bigger projects, two visits can work better. Renata will suggest what suits yours once she knows what work was done.

stages.label: Stage 1
stages.title: Builders’ clean
stages.text: The heavy dust-down: dust cleared from surfaces, fittings, skirting and floors, so you can see the finished work clearly and spot anything that needs snagging.

stages.label: Stage 2
stages.when: Before furniture goes back or you move in
stages.title: Final clean
stages.text: The detailed clean: kitchen and bathrooms, internal glass where safe and accessible, and floors vacuumed and mopped, ready to live in or hand over.

who.title: Homeowners
who.text: After an extension, loft conversion, refurbishment or new kitchen. Send a few photos and a note of what was done, and the quote will reflect how much dust and detail is really involved.

who.title: Builders and developers
who.text: Renata also works directly for builders and developers handing a property back to a client. Timing is agreed around your programme, so the clean happens after the last trade and before handover.

builders.faqTitle: Good to know before you book
limits: Book once building work has finished and trades are off site, so dust doesn’t settle again.
Paint splashes and adhesive residue are assessed separately.
Heavy waste and rubble removal aren’t offered.
Work at heights and exterior windows aren’t offered.

faqs.q: How soon after the work finishes should I book?
faqs.a: As soon as the trades are off site. If anyone is still working, dust will settle again behind the clean.

faqs.q: Will I need one visit or two?
faqs.a: It depends on the size of the project and how much dust there is. Renata will advise once she has seen photos.

faqs.q: What do you need from me for a quote?
faqs.a: A short description of the work, the size of the space and a few photos. Photos can be sent by WhatsApp.

deep.metaTitle: One-Off Deep Cleaning Wimbledon | Deep Cleaning by Renata
deep.metaDescription: One-off deep cleaning in Wimbledon, Putney, Richmond and Barnes: grease, limescale and dust tackled in detail, for homes and small commercial spaces.
deep.eyebrow: Before a sale, after a move, or when it’s overdue
deep.lede: A deep clean resets a home that needs more than a regular tidy. It goes into the grease, limescale and dust that build up over months, and the places a weekly clean doesn’t reach.
deep.whenTitle: When a deep clean makes sense

when.title: Before selling or letting
when.text: A clean home photographs better and feels better at viewings.

when.title: After moving in
when.text: Start fresh in a home someone else has lived in.

when.title: When it’s overdue
when.text: After a busy few months, an illness or a new baby, when the cleaning has slipped.

when.title: Before regular cleaning starts
when.text: Bring the home up to standard, so weekly or fortnightly visits can keep it there.

when.title: Small commercial spaces
when.text: Salons, small offices and short-let flats, as well as homes.

deep.compareIntro: Both are quoted individually. The difference is how far into the detail each one goes.
deep.compareCaption: Comparison table: one-off deep clean and regular clean

compare.deep: Homes that haven’t had a thorough clean for a while
compare.regular: Keeping a home on top of things

compare.deep: Once, or every now and then
Grease and limescale tackled in detail
compare.regular: Kept clean from visit to visit
As agreed in your cleaning plan

deep.compareLink: Looking for ongoing visits? See regular cleaning.
deep.timeIntro: Most of a deep clean is spent on a handful of jobs that build up slowly.

time.title: Grease in the kitchen
time.text: Cooker hood filters, splashbacks and cupboard fronts. Filters are soaked and degreased, not just wiped over.

time.title: Limescale in the bathroom
time.text: Shower trays, glass screens, taps and tiles, descaled with natural-based products.

time.title: Dust along the edges
time.text: Skirting boards, door frames and switches, which gather the dust a vacuum passes over.

deep.extras: Inside-oven cleaning, fridge or freezer cleaning, carpet cleaning and rubbish removal can be added to a deep clean, subject to availability and quoted separately.
deep.faqIntro: Anything else? Ask Renata on WhatsApp or by phone.

faqs.q: How long does a deep clean take?
faqs.a: It depends on the size and condition of the property, so you’ll get a time estimate with your quote.

faqs.q: Do you bring your own products?
faqs.a: Yes. Renata brings her own products and equipment, using products made with naturally derived ingredients, chosen with care for homes with people and pets. Mention any allergies or sensitivities before the clean.

faqs.q: Can you deep clean a salon or small office?
faqs.a: Yes. Small commercial spaces such as salons, small offices and short-let flats can be deep cleaned too. Describe the space and how it’s used, and Renata will quote for it.

regular.metaTitle: Regular House Cleaning Wimbledon | Deep Cleaning by Renata
regular.metaDescription: Weekly or fortnightly house cleaning in Wimbledon, Putney, Richmond and Barnes. Visits from 2 hours, a plan agreed with you, products supplied.
regular.eyebrow: Weekly or fortnightly, from 2 hours a visit
regular.lede: A clean home every week or fortnight, from the same person who quoted for it. Renata agrees a cleaning plan with you, brings her own products and equipment, and fits the visits around your household.

facts.detail: From 2 hours, depending on your home and your plan
Be at home, or Renata can hold a key
Renata, the owner, who also quotes and plans the work
Brought to every visit, including a vacuum cleaner and mop

regular.planTitle: A plan that fits your home
regular.plan1: Before the first visit, you and Renata agree what matters most: the rooms that need attention every time, and the jobs that can be done less often.
regular.plan2: The plan isn’t set in stone. If your routine or your priorities change, tell Renata and the plan can change with them.
regular.exampleTitle: For example, a plan might include
example: Skirting boards or internal windows on alternate visits
regular.exampleNote: Your own plan is agreed with you.
regular.startText: If your home hasn’t had a thorough clean for a while, a one-off deep clean first can bring it up to standard, so regular visits spend their time keeping it there. Renata can advise whether it’s worth it.
regular.commercialText: Regular cleaning isn’t only for homes. Renata also cleans small commercial spaces, such as salons, small offices and short-let flats, weekly or fortnightly. This pedicure station is from one of her salon jobs.
regular.faqIntro: Anything else? Ask Renata on WhatsApp or by phone.

faqs.q: Is there a minimum visit length?
faqs.a: Yes, visits are at least 2 hours. Larger homes or more detailed plans may need longer, and your quote will say how long.

faqs.q: Do I need to be home?
faqs.a: No. You can be at home if you prefer, or arrange for Renata to hold a key.

faqs.q: Will it be the same cleaner every time?
faqs.a: Deep Cleaning by Renata is run by Renata herself, so the person who quotes for your home is the person who cleans it.
